title: Excuse review side drawer (detail view before approve/reject)

mockup_description.layout: Right-side slide-in drawer, opened from the list row.
key_elements: Student header: photo, name, 'Élève ID', status badge, class, absence date
'Motif de l'absence' -- short tag + full free-text explanation
'Justificatif fourni': real filename, file size, PDF type, thumbnail preview, 'Aperçu' and download buttons
'Enregistrement de présence': which attendance record this excuse targets, marked-by + timestamp, current attendance status ('Absent (non justifié)')
'Statut actuel', 'Soumis le', 'Dernière mise à jour', 'Réviseur' (who's assigned to review, or 'Non révisé')
'Notes du réviseur (optionnel)' -- internal free-text note field, separate from the parent-facing reason
interactions: Reviewer can leave an internal note before deciding -- not visible to the parent, distinct from the public reason

what_matches: The underlying data mostly exists: attendanceExcuses row has reason/documentUrl/status/reviewedById/reviewedAt; the linked attendance row and guardian contact info are both reachable via existing tables (guardianStudents/guardians)
what_differs: No drawer/detail view at all currently -- approve/reject happen directly from inline row buttons in the table, with no intermediate review screen
No 'contact parent' info surfaced anywhere on the excuses page (real data exists via guardianStudents, just not queried/joined into this route yet)
No real document preview/thumbnail/download -- documentUrl is a bare optional URL string with no upload endpoint behind it (confirmed and left honest in this session's build, not faked)
No 'reviewer notes' internal field -- attendanceExcuses schema has no column for this
No display of the underlying attendance record's marked-by/timestamp on this screen

missing_to_add.item: Convert inline approve/reject buttons into a review drawer/modal, joining guardianStudents+guardians for the 'Contact parent' block

Real document upload for excuses: reuse src/libs/api/uploads.ts (the shared tenant-namespaced upload helper already used for student documents/photos), add a real POST endpoint accepting a file for attendanceExcuses.documentUrl instead of a bare string, add PDF preview/thumbnail + download in the UI
missing_to_add.notes: This was explicitly flagged as a known, honest gap in this session's completion report -- the plumbing pattern to copy already exists elsewhere in the app.

missing_to_add.item: reviewerNotes column on attendanceExcuses (small migration) + UI field
